page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 2 physical cores and 2 vCPUs with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor, includes a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and does not bundle any local storage or GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core execution, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core tests, falls into the average category. However, multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core metrics, is rated as poor. Memory bandwidth tests for both read and write operations also register in the bottom 10%, which represents a significant bottleneck for memory-intensive operations despite the high memory capacity.

Given the 8:1 memory-to-CPU ratio, this instance is classified under memory-optimized workloads. However, the weak database operations and poor Redis SET performance benchmarks suggest it is less suited for high-throughput transactional databases. It is best utilized for memory-bound applications with low CPU concurrency requirements, such as small-scale caching, text processing, or lightweight single-threaded background workers where memory capacity is prioritized over raw processing speed and memory bandwidth.
